afterForty.heading: Life after 42: 98% employment.
afterForty.description: 98% of students who complete the advanced curriculum secure a job. Many are recruited during internships or while still working on projects at 42. You graduate with a portfolio, a track record, and a global alumni network in every major tech city.

stat.label: of advanced grads secure a job

afterForty.communityNote: Graduation doesn't mean goodbye. Alumni are students for life - always welcome back to campus to exchange, mentor, or keep learning.

whatYouBuild.heading: What you'll actually build.
whatYouBuild.intro: The 42 Belgium program is structured around real projects, not lectures. Four phases, one trajectory - from your first line of code to your career launch.

phases.title: Core Curriculum
phases.description: You learn to code from scratch, then build your way up through progressively harder projects. The Common Core gives every student a solid foundation - both hard and soft skills.
items: **Languages** - C, Python, and others along the way
**Algorithms & data structures** - the logic behind every codebase
**UNIX, file systems, processes** - how software actually runs
**Network programming** - the architecture behind modern apps
**Client-server projects** - building the backend of real systems
**Web programming** - from HTML to full-stack deployment
**Artificial intelligence** - the fundamentals powering modern systems

phases.title: First work experience
phases.description: After the Common Core, many students take a first internship or job in tech. Not mandatory, but strongly recommended. This phase often helps students confirm their interests and return to 42 with clearer goals.
items: **Understand professional workflows**, tools, and team dynamics

phases.title: Advanced Curriculum
phases.description:
Choose your specialisation and go deeper - up to a master-equivalent level.

**How it works:** Like in a video game, you can try, fail, and try again until you succeed. As you complete and validate projects, your level increases to reflect the skills you've mastered along the way. At each level, you discover new areas of coding and IT. This makes every student's journey unique, while still covering a shared foundation.
flexibility: You are not obligated to stick to one specialisation or complete it fully.
You can move between tracks, experiment with different fields, and choose projects that fit your goals.
Each student is free to decide when to graduate and officially become a 42 Alumni.
phases.globalMobility: This phase can be pursued not only in Brussels or Antwerp but also at any other 42 campus worldwide.

phases.title: Career launch
phases.description: Many students secure job offers during this phase - often before they officially graduate. Industry certifications (AWS and others) add professional credibility.
items: **Put advanced skills into practice** in longer, specialised roles
**Secure long-term opportunities** - many receive offers here

whatYouBuild.plusNote: Plus: industry certifications (AWS cloud and others), and a philosophy of sharing that shapes how you learn.

realStories.heading: Real stories from real students.
realStories.description: Three alumni share what the 42 journey was like - in their own words.

howToApply.heading: How to join 42 Belgium.

steps.title: Online logic test (~1 hour)
steps.description: No coding needed, it's just logic. Choose a quiet spot, as you can't pause or restart. Stay focused and keep going - you've got this!

steps.title: Meeting - on campus or online
steps.description:
Come visit our campus in Brussels or Antwerp and learn more about the program.

Some check-in sessions are also online, but don't forget to register!

steps.title: Enter the Piscine
steps.description: You'll be immersed for 4 weeks on our campus in Brussels or Antwerp. You'll get a taste of coding, our unique approach, and life at 42. Enough to really know if 42 is for you.

steps.title: Start the Common Core
steps.description:
After passing the Piscine, you can officially start the Core Program.

You'll have 24/7 access to the campus, work on real projects, and discover a community full of fellow coders.

howToApply.microcopy: Next Piscine dates on campus - apply anytime.

openDays.heading: Come meet us at an Open Day.
openDays.intro: No pressure, no commitment. Walk the campus, meet the team, ask every question you have - in Brussels or Antwerp.

campuses.name: Brussels
campuses.description: A two-minute walk from the Central Station. Visit the campus, meet current students, see how peer-to-peer learning actually looks.

campuses.name: Antwerp
campuses.subHeading: In the heart of the city.
campuses.description: Our Antwerp campus sits in the thick of the city's creative and media district, in the DPG building. Come spend an afternoon with the team.
